The Prescription Summary provides an overview of the patient's therapy details, including
prescribed therapy and supplies.

Clicking the
icon, Figure 4-1 (C), takes you to the Prescription section under the Therapy
Management tab, where you can view and edit the patient’s therapy details and supplies
treatment plan. For more information, see the Therapy Management section.

The Prescription section provides an overview of the patient's therapy details, including
prescribed therapy and supplies. To update information, click the field you want to edit.

After making the necessary changes in Therapy section, click the Save button, Figure 4-7 (A),
to save the updated therapy details successfully. To discard edits and restore the original
values, click Clear, Figure 4-7 (B).

Similarly, after making updates in the Supplies section, click the Save button, Figure 4-7 (C),
to save the changes. To revert to the original values, click Clear, Figure 4-7 (D).

The Supplies section of the prescription displays approved prescription values from Order
Manager. Please refer to Order Manager documentation for more information on the
prescription fields and process for prescription approval.

When entering values outside of the range set for that field, the field will be highlighted in red
and save button will be disabled as shown in Figure 4-8.

Clicking on a treatment from the list will open its corresponding Treatment Flowsheet. Here,
you can view the flowsheet details, such as start time, duration, and status.

The Treatment Flowsheet screen includes the following tabs to easily access its main
functions.

•
Summary – Provides an overview of the treatment; see Summary for more
information.

•
Cycler Data – Displays cycler-related data; see Cycler Data for more information.

•
Vitals, Medication & Equipment – Displays vital signs, medications, and equipment
information. See Vitals, Medication & Equipment for more information.

The Medication section displays medications administered during treatment. Clicking the
icon, Figure 5-4 (I), takes you to the Vitals, Medication & Equipment tab, where you can
view detailed mediation information. For more information, see the Vitals, Medication &
Equipment section.

The Treatment Flowsheet – Vitals, Medication & Equipment tab displays detailed
information about the patient’s vital signs, medications, and equipment data for that treatment.

The Medication section displays medications administered during the treatment, as entered
by the patient in the Nx2me app, Figure 5-17. It includes the following details:

•
Time Administered: Time the medication was administered, as entered by the
patient in the Nx2me app.

•
Name: The name of the medication administered, as entered by the patient in the
Nx2me app.

•
Dose: The dose of the medication administered, as entered by the patient in the
Nx2me app.

•
Route: The location where the medication was administered, as entered by the
patient in the Nx2me app.
